capabilities.name: Dry-run context pack handoff builder
limitations: Generates schema-validated local handoff reports from explicit source-family selections over documented harness project files, explicit user-selected relative files, compact native JS/TS source-graph hints, a utility read plan, and a copyable launch prompt
Omission refs expose skipped context through safe locators, hashes, token costs, reason codes, and recovery hints without embedding raw bodies

Utility read plans record required local reads, changed-locator coverage, graph-hint coverage, redacted content hashes for safely readable changed files, unavailable-hash reasons for missing or unsafe changed files, explicit user-selected files omitted by budget, and source-selection reduction without embedding raw source bodies

Context packs preserve requested source families, user-selected locators, and changed locators in schema-backed requestedInputs, and reject secret-like or absolute-path objective and step text before rendering handoff markdown

Opt-in read-only MCP context-pack summary resource exposes source-family selection, locators, fingerprints, omission counts, source-selection token counts, delivery-budget metrics, changed-file impact, and utility coverage counts without raw objective text, raw step text, markdown bodies, or source bodies

Explicit CLI export can write both context-packs/*.md markdown and context-packs/*.use.json sanitized use plans; the use plan carries complete required local reads, content hashes, coverage, delivery metrics, artifact hashes, and pack fingerprints without changing the pack object's dry-run semantics

Explicit CLI pinning writes context-packs/*.md, context-packs/*.use.json, context-packs/registry.json, and context-packs/current.json, then read-only registry status verifies artifact hashes, required source hashes, registry fingerprints, current-pointer fingerprints, stale source changes, and tampered exports without exposing markdown or source content
Read-only MCP context-pack use-plan resources load only schema-validated context-packs/*.use.json files and reject arbitrary paths before serving the complete required-read plan
Read-only MCP context-pack registry resources expose schema-validated verification status for pinned local context-pack artifacts without exposing write tools or private content

Control API context-pack builds include an in-process read-only MCP resource readback proof for the freshly built pack, including fingerprint match, byte size, zero exposed tools, and no markdown body

Local MCP context-pack smoke report proves the stdio resources/list, tools/list, and resources/read path with observed one-run duration, byte sizes, selected/candidate source units, and delivered-handoff units
Raw source bodies, prompts, outputs, credentials, provider URLs, private local paths, and hidden reasoning are omitted

No automatic harness chat history import, active memory activation, model call, external adapter, outbound network, persisted graph database, graph candidate-source integration, publishing, or external write
The only context-pack write paths are explicit CLI outputs under context-packs/*.md, context-packs/*.use.json, context-packs/registry.json, and context-packs/current.json
